query: Recent French 2027 presidential first-round voting intention polls testing Marine Le Pen by name, June-July 2026, with pollster, fieldwork dates, and Le Pen percentage. Include Ifop, Harris Interactive, Toluna, Elabe, Odoxa, IFOP polls.
answer:
I've compiled the research on French 2027 presidential first-round polls testing Marine Le Pen by name for June–July 2026. Here's the summary:

## Key Findings

**Marine Le Pen announced her candidacy on 7 July 2026**, triggering a wave of polls showing her first-round share jumping +3 to +4 points to **34–36%**.

### July 2026 polls (post-announcement):
| Pollster | Commissioner | Fieldwork | Le Pen 1st round |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Ifop** | LCI/Le Figaro/Sud Radio | 7–8 July 2026 | **36%** |
| **Toluna Harris Interactive** | M6/RTL (Vague 3) | 8 July 2026 | **34–36%** |
| **Elabe** | BFMTV/La Tribune Dim. | 9–10 July 2026 | **34–35.5%** |

### June/May 2026 polls (pre-announcement, testing Bardella as lead RN candidate):
| Pollster | Fieldwork | Le Pen 1st round |
|---|---|---|
| Ifop-Fiducial | 22–24 June 2026 | 32% |
| Toluna Harris Interactive (Vague 2) | 25–27 May 2026 | 31–32% |
| Ifop-Fiducial | 26–28 May 2026 | 31% |

### Notes on your requested pollsters:
- **Ifop / Harris Interactive (Toluna) / Elabe**: full data found and cited above.
- **Odoxa**: Its barometers (Odoxa-Mascaret for Public Sénat/regional press) primarily led with **Bardella** (~31.5–32% first round) rather than isolating Le Pen by name. A spring-2026 conviction-period Odoxa reading placed Le Pen at ~32% with Philippe winning the 2nd round 54–46. I could not confirm a distinct June–July 2026 Odoxa figure isolating Le Pen by name beyond that.

In all July 2026 polls Le Pen wins her tested second rounds (e.g., Ifop 54–46 vs Philippe, 55–45 vs Attal, 70–30 vs Mélenchon). Édouard Philippe is consistently her strongest challenger (16.5–20%). These are polling simulations, not forecasts (±2–3 pt margin); the first round is scheduled for 18 April 2027.

sources.snippet: Marine Le Pen serait très largement en tête au premier tour: entre 34% et 35,5%, en progression de 3 points depuis mars 2026.

sources.title: Intentions de vote à l'élection présidentielle 2027 (Toluna Harris Interactive)
sources.snippet: Enquête réalisée en ligne du 25 au 27 mai 2026, 1744 personnes. Marine Le Pen 31% à 32%, Bardella 31-34%.

sources.title: Présidentielle 2027 : Marine Le Pen largement en tête devant Édouard Philippe, selon deux sondages
sources.snippet: Ifop pour LCI/Le Figaro: Le Pen 36% (échantillon 984 dans les heures suivant l'annonce). Toluna M6/RTL: Le Pen 34-36%.
